pages.h1: How to Get Your Resume Past ATS
pages.primaryKeyword: how to get resume past ats
pages.brief: Backlog P022 (Step 12 disposition: Keep). Search intent: informational how-to, MOFU. Explain accurately how applicant tracking systems generally work (they store and let recruiters search/filter applications; most modern ATS do not auto-reject resumes on formatting alone, but poor formatting, missing standard section headings, or images/tables can still make a resume hard for the system or a recruiter to parse). Give concrete formatting guidance (standard fonts and headings, no text in images/headers/footers, no multi-column layouts that scramble parsing order, save as the requested file type). Cover keyword matching honestly: matching the job description's actual terms where they describe real experience helps a recruiter searching the system find the resume, but repeating a term with no supporting evidence does not help. Never claim any method 'guarantees' passing an ATS — that behavior cannot be fully verified from the outside and varies by vendor. This guide owns the informational how-to intent; a separate feature page (ATS resume optimizer) and a separate free checker tool own the diagnostic/optimization intent, so do not turn this into a product pitch. Mention the ATS resume optimizer feature once near the end as an option for the diagnosis step.
